city_fields.supportSceneAlt: A doula supporting an expectant mom on a sunny Corona, California street with the Cleveland National Forest hills and palm trees in the background
city_fields.culture: Corona sits at the junction of the 91 and 15 freeways in western Riverside County, a fast-growing family city framed by the Cleveland Hills and the Santa Ana River canyon. Its Southern California location gives families true choice in birth: a handful of freestanding midwife-led birth centers operate right in town, while higher-acuity births head just minutes away to Riverside and the Inland Empire's Level III hospitals. The local doula community serves a broad, culturally diverse population, including a strong Spanish-speaking cohort reflecting Corona's large Latino community.
city_fields.medicaidNote: Yes — California's Medi-Cal covers doula services statewide as of January 2023 under SB-509. Reimbursement is approximately $1,841 per birth package, including prenatal visits, labor support, and postpartum visits. Doulas must enroll as Medi-Cal providers through the Department of Health Care Services (DHCS) and bill via the PAVE portal.
